name: Teaching The Word
overview: Scripture emphasizes the vital role of teaching the Word in nurturing faith and guiding believers. From training children in the way they should go (Proverbs 22:6) to fulfilling Christ’s command to make disciples of all nations (Matthew 28:19), teaching is foundational to spiritual growth. The Holy Spirit actively teaches and reminds believers of Christ’s truths (John 14:26), while the Word of God itself is powerful and discerning, shaping hearts and minds (Hebrews 4:12). As faith comes through hearing the Word (Romans 10:17), believers are called to let the Word dwell richly within them, teaching and admonishing one another with wisdom and grace (Colossians 3:16).
